name: data-table-sticky-columns
title: Data table: Sticky header and pinned columns
description: Twenty-one columns that scroll both ways inside the table, with the header, first column and actions held in place.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

files.content:
// Every field of every invoice: 21 columns in a box that scrolls both ways. The header row sticks to // the top, the invoice number stays pinned on the left and the actions on the right; the switches // unpin them. Totals sit in the footer. "use client" import type { ColumnDef } from "@tanstack/react-table" import { CircleAlertIcon, CircleCheckIcon, ClockIcon, DownloadIcon, EyeIcon, FilePenLineIcon, MoreHorizontalIcon, SendIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch" import { DataTable } from "@/components/ui/data-table" import { DataTableColumnHeader } from "@/components/ui/data-table-column-header" type Status = "Paid" | "Due" | "Overdue" | "Draft" type Invoice = { id: string client: string contact: string email: string project: string owner: string issued: string due: string terms: string status: Status subtotal: number discount: number tax: number total: number paid: number balance: number daysLate: number method: string reminders: number lastReminder?: string } const CLIENTS = [ ["Fernwood Studio", "Mara Lind", "mara@fernwood.studio"], ["Kato & Lee", "Ken Kato", "ken@katolee.com"], ["Juniper Labs", "Theo Grant", "theo@juniperlabs.dev"], ["Ola Bakery", "Ola Bergstrom", "hello@olabakery.com"], ["Pellucid Health", "Ravi Shah", "accounts@pellucid.health"], ["Alder Coffee", "Sam Alder", "sam@aldercoffee.com"], ["Mossgrove Architects", "Paul Moss", "paul@mossgrove.co.uk"], ["Saltmarsh Films", "Nadia Cole", "nadia@saltmarsh.film"], ["Tidewater Co.", "Hana Ito", "hana@tidewater.co"], ["Quill & Ink", "Bea Marsh", "bea@quillandink.co"], ] as const const PROJECTS = ["Website refresh", "Spring campaign", "Packaging redesign", "Product shoot", "Monthly retainer", "Annual report", "App onboarding", "Brand guidelines"] const OWNERS = ["Ada Ruiz", "Tom Okafor", "Maya Lindqvist", "Leo Brandt"] const METHODS = ["Bank transfer", "Card", "ACH debit", "Bank transfer", "Card"] const DAY = 86_400_000 const TODAY = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 24) const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] const iso = (t: number) => new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0, 10) const formatDate = (d?: string) => (d ? `${MONTHS[Number(d.slice(5, 7)) - 1]} ${Number(d.slice(8, 10))}, ${d.slice(0, 4)}` : "—") const usd = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }) const INVOICES: Invoice[] = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => { const [client, contact, email] = CLIENTS[(i * 7 + 3) % CLIENTS.length] const issuedAt = TODAY - (i * 4 + (i % 3)) * DAY const termDays = [14, 30, 30, 7][i % 4] const dueAt = issuedAt + termDays * DAY const status: Status = i < 3 ? "Draft" : dueAt >= TODAY ? "Due" : i % 6 === 1 && i < 34 ? "Overdue" : "Paid" const subtotal = 480 + ((i * 37) % 23) * 185 + (i % 4) * 25 const discount = i % 5 === 0 ? Math.round(subtotal * 0.1) : 0 const tax = Math.round((subtotal - discount) * 8) / 100 const total = subtotal - discount + tax const paid = status === "Paid" ? total : status === "Overdue" && i % 4 === 1 ? Math.round(total / 2) : 0 const daysLate = status === "Overdue" ? Math.round((TODAY - dueAt) / DAY) : 0 const reminders = status === "Overdue" ? 1 + (daysLate > 20 ? 1 : 0) : status === "Due" && i % 3 === 0 ? 1 : 0 return { id: `INV-${1040 - i}`, client, contact, email, project: PROJECTS[(i * 5) % PROJECTS.length], owner: OWNERS[i % OWNERS.length], issued: iso(issuedAt), due: iso(dueAt), terms: termDays === 7 ? "Net 7" : `Net ${termDays}`, status, subtotal, discount, tax, total, paid, balance: total - paid, daysLate, method: status === "Draft" ? "—" : METHODS[i % METHODS.length], reminders, lastReminder: reminders ? iso(TODAY - ((i % 5) + 1) * DAY) : undefined, } }) const STATUS: Record; variant: "secondary" | "outline" | "destructive" }> = { Overdue: { icon: CircleAlertIcon, variant: "destructive" }, Due: { icon: ClockIcon, variant: "outline" }, Draft: { icon: FilePenLineIcon, variant: "outline" }, Paid: { icon: CircleCheckIcon, variant: "secondary" }, } type MoneyKey = "subtotal" | "discount" | "tax" | "total" | "paid" | "balance" const money = (key: MoneyKey, title: string): ColumnDef => ({ accessorKey: key, meta: { label: title, align: "right" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => { const v = row.original[key] return {usd.format(key === "discount" && v ? -v : v)} }, footer: ({ table }) => { const sum = table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.original[key], 0) return {usd.format(key === "discount" && sum ? -sum : sum)} }, }) const text = (key: "client" | "contact" | "email" | "project" | "owner" | "terms" | "method", title: string, muted = false): ColumnDef => ({ accessorKey: key, meta: { label: title }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {row.original[key]}, }) const date = (key: "issued" | "due" | "lastReminder", title: string): ColumnDef => ({ id: key, accessorFn: (row) => row[key] ?? "", meta: { label: title }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {formatDate(row.original[key])}, }) const columns: ColumnDef[] = [ { accessorKey: "id", size: 128, enableHiding: false, meta: { label: "Invoice" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {row.original.id}, footer: "Total", }, text("client", "Client"), text("contact", "Contact"), text("email", "Email", true), text("project", "Project"), text("owner", "Owner"), date("issued", "Issued"), date("due", "Due"), text("terms", "Terms", true), { accessorKey: "status", meta: { label: "Status" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => { const { icon: Icon, variant } = STATUS[row.original.status] return ( {row.original.status} ) }, }, money("subtotal", "Subtotal"), money("discount", "Discount"), money("tax", "Tax"), money("total", "Total"), money("paid", "Paid"), money("balance", "Balance"), { accessorKey: "daysLate", meta: { label: "Days late", align: "right" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => row.original.daysLate ? {row.original.daysLate} : —, }, text("method", "Paid by", true), { accessorKey: "reminders", meta: { label: "Reminders", align: "right" }, header: ({ column }) => , cell: ({ row }) => {row.original.reminders}, }, date("lastReminder", "Last reminder"), { id: "actions", size: 56, enableHiding: false, header: () => Actions, cell: ({ row }) => ( }> View invoice Download PDF Send reminder ), }, ] export default function DataTableStickyColumns() { return (
